description: Information about the LMDB environment, its collection of databases. Uses the mdb_env_info() routine.

mapaddr.description: Address of database map in RAM.
mapaddr.label: Map Address

mapsize.description: Size of database map in RAM.
mapsize.label: Map Size

maxreaders.description: Maximum number of reader slots allocated for the environment. Equivalent to the value maxreaders specified by the first process opening the Environment.
maxreaders.label: Max Readers

numreaders.description: Maximum number of reader slots that have been in simultaneous use since the environment was opened.
numreaders.label: Number Readers
